name: ML-MD Weighted Ensemble Benchmark
description: Provides a standardized benchmark protocol for machine-learned molecular dynamics using weighted ensemble sampling to compare ML potential performance on dynamical observables and sampling efficiency.
evaluation_method: RMSE and sampling_efficiency (e.g., effective sample size, variance of dynamical observables)
general_score_metric: sampling_efficiency (effective sample size) and MSE on dynamical observables
reputation: A specialized protocol valued in the molecular-dynamics and ML-for-molecular-systems community for standardized comparison of ML potentials under weighted-ensemble sampling, but adoption is primarily within that niche.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; computationally expensive to run; results sensitive to reference dynamics, hyperparameters, and ensemble setup; not a small/quick dataset and requires careful reproducibility controls.
